source: NOAA NCEP GFS 0.25-degree analysis (gfs.tHHz.pgrb2.0p25.f000) of the same cycle: ICEC, sea-ice area fraction
time_policy: the same cycle's analysis, broadcast to every valid time of the window (sea ice is frozen during the forecast); nearest published 0.25-degree cell
why: ECMWF open data (0.25 and 0.1 degree) publishes sea-ice thickness only, no concentration, at every lead (indexes checked 2026-10-28); thickness is never read as a fraction
